current_date: Updated March 2024 (approved 21 March 2024); reviewed March 2026; in place until 31 March 2028
current_evidence: The council's 'Making a planning application' page still links this exact Validation Guidance PDF (plus the matrix, biodiversity appendix and 16 checklist forms) and states the requirements 'were updated in March 2024, reviewed in March 2026 and remain in place until 31 March 2028'; the council decision record shows the Local Validation List approved 21 Mar 2024.

issues.detail: List date 2024-11-01 is taken from PDF metadata, not the document. The list was approved on 21 March 2024 and published as 'updated March 2024' (the checklist forms are dated March 2024). The council reviewed it in March 2026 and it stays in force until 31 March 2028, so the 'Outdated (>2y)? = Yes' flag is wrong.
issues.evidence: Planning page: 'These were updated in March 2024, reviewed in March 2026 and remain in place until 31 March 2028.' Checklist form extracts quoted by Grokbot read 'March 2024'.

issues.detail: The source PDFs (validation-guidance.pdf, validation-checklist-matrix.pdf) could not be fetched for this audit because the site blocks automated fetching (robots disallow). The contents comparison below rests on Grokbot's own quoted extracts and the council page, not on a full re-read of the guidance.
issues.evidence: WebFetch: 'failed at its site (robots_disallowed)' for /download/downloads/id/15909 and /15878.

issues.detail: The tab_items hold only 33 rows, and almost none of them are requirements. They are drawing standards, form descriptions, submission rules and a few biodiversity checklist fragments. The topic-by-topic requirements in Section 6 of the guidance (6.1 to 6.29) are not captured as tab items. Several requirements show up in Grokbot's own excerpts but never appear as requirement rows: Affordable Housing Statement (a matrix row), Parking and Servicing provision (in the householder/dropped kerb form) and Heritage Impact Assessment (in the forms, but captured only under Works to trees). Listed building consent has no heritage statement row at all.
issues.evidence: Matrix extract: 'Tree Works Air Quality Assessment Essential Requirement Potential Requirement Aﬀordable Housing Statement'; dropped kerb form extract: 'Requirement Parking and Servicing provision Tree Survey, Report and Protection'.

issues.detail: The 'Change of use - prior approval' rows (block plan, DAS, floor plans/elevations) come from the full-planning Change of Use checklist (id 15893), not the Part 3 Prior Approval checklist (id 15903). Grokbot read the 15903 form but never used it.
issues.evidence: Rows sourced from change-of-use---validation-checklist-form.pdf; the planning page lists 'Part 3 Prior Approvals' as a separate form (15903).

issues.detail: The requirements from the 'Removal/Variation/Discharge of Condition' form (15904) are placed under 'Discharge of conditions', while 'Variation of condition s73' says 'No specific local requirements identified'. The form covers removal and variation (s73) as well, so the s73 entry is wrong.
issues.evidence: Planning page link text: 'Removal/Variation/Discharge of Condition'; Grokbot s73 row: '(none) ... national requirements only'.

issues.detail: Householder 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey' comes from the separate Householder (Dropped Kerb) access checklist (15895), not the main householder form. Its trigger excerpt is a garbled run of table headers and doesn't say when a tree survey applies.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'Requirement Parking and Servicing provision Tree Survey, Report and Protection March 2024 Included Y/N If No, please state why detail is not required' (source householder-dropped-kerb form).

issues.detail: Summary of the inferred placements: about 20 Full planning rows are marked 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. Examples are Air Quality, Noise, Lighting, Transport, Flood Risk, Drainage/SuDS, Viability, Fire Statement, EIA, HRA and BNG. The council has a crib-sheet matrix and separate forms for minor residential (<10), major residential (10-49), 50+ units, non-residential <1ha and >1ha. Grokbot didn't use these to assign application types, so the minor/major and residential/commercial distinctions are lost.
issues.evidence: Notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list'; matrix 'Essential Requirement / Potential Requirement' columns per application type.

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or have nothing to do with the trigger. FRA: 'The FRA should include a surface water drainage strategy.' (no flood zone or site area threshold). Swift bricks/boxes: 'deadwood, bird / bat box (i.e. features which may be a bat roost). x.' Ecology (Full): 'required) report/Ecological surveys/PEA/species surveys) January 2024'. DAS and Fire Statement are cut off mid-list ('all major development p...', 'two or more...'). Most of the form-based rows ('Block plan', 'Floor plans', 'DAS') just repeat the form's boilerplate 'In addition to the national requirements set out above...'.
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields as quoted.

issues.detail: Three Full planning rows have the wrong name for their excerpt. 'Advertisement drawings / illumination details' is the external lighting section (6.19) running into 6.20 Noise. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is a sentence about test method statements (contamination/percolation), not a listed-building schedule. 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' is the noise impact assessment trigger.
issues.evidence: '...including luminance levels, security sensors, timers & switches ... 6.20 Noise I'; 'required, including a method statement detailing how the tests were carried out.'; '...ventilation, extraction or air-cooling equipment, near residential properties, a noise impact assessment is required.'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process text or boilerplate, not requirements. Examples: the validation disputes procedure with an email address; the GDPR/personal data note; 'See the Council's website on how to report a Noise Nuisance'; generic 'Please use this checklist and submit the completed list' descriptions for 13 forms; the Tree Officers' Association note about referring invalid 211 notices back to the applicant.
issues.evidence: '2 Validation Disputes 2.1 If you disagree ... email dcregistration@cherwell-dc.gov.uk'; 'Incomplete or invalid applications or 211 notices should be referred back to the applicant/agent or the relevant tree officer.'

issues.detail: Two Lawful development certificate rows don't belong there. A Design and Access Statement is never required for an LDC; the row is form boilerplate ('if required'). The CLUE form is used for both LDC types, and the separate CLUP form (15897) isn't reflected.
issues.evidence: Trigger: 'Location Plan Design and Access Statement (if required) Cherwell Local Validation List requirements for an application of this type...'

issues.detail: Tab items repeat themselves. 'All drawings & plans to be provided on the same paper size' appears twice, and 'all plans to be submitted as separate single page PDF files' / 'Multipage PDF files may/will not be accepted' appear twice each.

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's current Validation Guidance: updated March 2024, reviewed March 2026 and valid to March 2028. The list date (PDF metadata, Nov 2024) and the 'outdated' flag are wrong. The PDFs block automated fetching, so contents could not be fully re-checked. Grokbot's own extracts show weak capture: tab items are mostly process text, application types are mis-mapped (prior approval, s73, dropped kerb) and many triggers are fragments or mislabelled.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
